fix gateway_callback_body (identifier : BinNums.positive) (body : Clight.statement) {struct body} : bool :=
  match body with
  | Clight.Sassign first second =>
      (gateway_callback_expression identifier first || gateway_callback_expression identifier second)%bool
  | Clight.Scall _ _ arguments | Clight.Sbuiltin _ _ _ arguments =>
      List.existsb (gateway_callback_expression identifier) arguments
  | Clight.Sifthenelse condition first second =>
      (gateway_callback_expression identifier condition || gateway_callback_body identifier first
       || gateway_callback_body identifier second)%bool
  | Clight.Ssequence first second | Clight.Sloop first second =>
      (gateway_callback_body identifier first || gateway_callback_body identifier second)%bool
  | Clight.Sset _ value | Clight.Sreturn (Some value) => gateway_callback_expression identifier value
  | Clight.Sswitch condition branches =>
      (gateway_callback_expression identifier condition || gateway_callback_cases identifier branches)%bool
  | Clight.Slabel _ nested => gateway_callback_body identifier nested
  | _ => false
  end

  match branches with
  | Clight.LSnil => false
  | Clight.LScons _ body rest => (gateway_callback_body identifier body || gateway_callback_cases identifier rest)%bool
